  i.website,

rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_core AS (
SELECT
  -- canonical institution name: prefer institutions_name (already canonical in source)
  institutions_name::text AS institutions_name,

  -- primary key carried through
  unics_id::integer AS unics_id,

  -- country: preserve raw country_id and also ensure it's an integer (nullable)
  country_id::integer AS country_id,

  -- geocode_regions_3: preserve raw value but canonicalize empty strings to NULL and trim whitespace
  NULLIF(trim(geocode_regions_3), '') AS geocode_regions_3,

  -- short_name: trim and null-empty strings for consistency
  NULLIF(trim(short_name), '') AS short_name,

  -- acronym: uppercase trimmed acronym, null if empty
  NULLIF(upper(trim(acronym)), '') AS acronym,

  -- website: normalize common noise by trimming; keep as-is otherwise
  NULLIF(trim(website), '') AS website,

  -- grid_id: trim and null-empty
  NULLIF(trim(grid_id), '') AS grid_id,

  -- wikidata_url: trim and null-empty
  NULLIF(trim(wikidata_url), '') AS wikidata_url,

  -- db_pedia_url: trim and null-empty
  NULLIF(trim(db_pedia_url), '') AS db_pedia_url,

  -- document_vectors: carry through (tsvector)
  document_vectors
FROM institutions
),
institutions_country_lookup AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  i.country_id AS country_id,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  c.country_code2 AS country_code2,
  c.country_code3 AS country_code3,
  c.geocode_country_code AS geocode_country_code
FROM institutions i

  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT institutions_name
FROM institutions_core

rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    p.ec_fund_scheme,
    p.total_cost,
    p.ec_max_contribution,
    p.principal_investigator
  FROM projects p
),
topics_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    t.title AS title,
    t.rcn AS rcn
  FROM topics t
),
project_topics_link AS (
  SELECT
    project_topics.project AS project,
    project_topics.topic  AS topic
  FROM project_topics
  UNION
  SELECT
    project_programmes.project AS project,
    project_programmes.programme AS topic
  FROM project_programmes
  WHERE project_programmes.programme IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT
    project_subject_areas.project AS project,
    project_subject_areas.subject_area AS topic
  FROM project_subject_areas
  WHERE project_subject_areas.subject_area IS NOT NULL
)

FROM projects_row_level p
JOIN project_topics_link l ON p.unics_id = l.project
JOIN topics_canonical t ON l.topic = t.code
WHERE p.end_date BETWEEN DATE '2014-01-01' AND DATE '2014-12-31'

    regexp_replace(trim(institutions_name), '\s+', ' ', 'g') AS institutions_name,
    -- primary id: carry through

  FROM institutions
),
countries_core AS (
  SELECT
    unics_id,
    country_name
  FROM countries
),

    i.institutions_name,
    i.country_id,

)

FROM institutions_with_country

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_with_valid_years AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
),
project_duration_aggregates_by_project AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year,
    (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects_with_valid_years p
)
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.duration_years
FROM project_duration_aggregates_by_project p
WHERE p.duration_years = (
  SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM project_duration_aggregates_by_project
)
ORDER BY p.unics_id ASC
